- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks, viewport no wider than 1280px, and inspect only the latest screenshot.

- Built a self-contained browser game with original creature names and a tactical operation loop.
- Used localStorage for saves and included operations, ranks, hideout upgrades, roster, and boss-rank expansion.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created the responsive game UI and gameplay in `index.html`, `style.css`, and `app.js`.
- Verified JavaScript syntax, loaded the page in headless Chromium, and exercised a successful capture and hideout navigation; no page errors.
- Saved and inspected `screenshots/rocket-ops.jpg`.

1. Summarize the implemented game and note the assumption of using original creature names.

- `index.html`: Game screens and layout.
- `style.css`: Responsive styling and game visuals.
- `app.js`: Missions, capture mechanics, progression, upgrades, and save data.
- `screenshots/rocket-ops.jpg`: Latest gameplay screenshot.

- Changes are uncommitted.
- Tested successful capture flow and hideout view; `node --check app.js` passed.

content.text:
Built a playable browser game in `index.html`, `style.css`, and `app.js`.

- Run tactical operations to recruit original creatures, earn cash and reputation, and climb through six ranks.
- Unlock hideout upgrades as you progress; at Boss rank, expand the compound and increase roster capacity.
- Progress saves locally in the browser.

I checked the capture flow and hideout view, and saved a screenshot at `screenshots/rocket-ops.jpg`. The workspace changes are uncommitted. Assumption: creatures use original names rather than official Pokémon.
